title: Being separated, quasi-separated, quasi-DM or DM is inherited by the fibre products of test spaces and by the Isom sheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement records that for a separated, quasi-separated, quasi-DM or DM morphism of algebraic stacks the comparison map between the fibre products of two test spaces and the comparison map between the two Isom sheaves inherit the corresponding property, in four variants at once (author lemma at source lines 1851-1874, label lemma-separated-implies-isom). The proof (source lines 1876-1898) identifies the relevant square as cartesian and invokes the diagonal characterisation of the hypothesis for the first assertion, and writes the Isom sheaf as a fibre product exhibiting the second morphism as a base change of the first (proof lines 1877-1897). The two identifications of fibre products are the content. H2.
